startIn.provenance: APPROX: CAD, AgateFlow.ROBOT_FRONT 7.99 (intake front) + ROBOT_BACK 5.72 (chassis back) long, 2 x ROBOT_HALF_WIDTH 5.87 (outer frame rails) wide, flower intake up; TODO(8) and TODO(13) tape checks

expandedIn.provenance: APPROX: the startIn box. AgateFlow plans every drive with the flower intake up; lowered it reaches IntakePoses.FLOWER_INTAKE_REACH 10.84 in ahead of the turret centre, which this box leaves out

centreOfRotationIn.provenance: APPROX: poses are the turret centre (what the Pinpoint tracks); the box centre is (7.99 - 5.72) / 2 = 1.135 in ahead of it

maxForwardVelInPerS.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: agateflow/DriveModel.FALLBACK_FORWARD_SPEED, a guess until ForesightTuner measures maxAchievableForwardVelocity, TODO(2)

maxStrafeVelInPerS.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: agateflow/DriveModel.FALLBACK_STRAFE_SPEED, a guess until ForesightTuner measures maxAchievableStrafeVelocity, TODO(2)

forwardDecelInPerS2.provenance: APPROX: derived from DriveModel's fallback brake model, stop distance 0.06 v + 0.002 v^2 = 19.55 in from 85 in/s, so v^2 / (2 d); guesses until ForesightTuner, TODO(2)

strafeDecelInPerS2.provenance: APPROX: derived from DriveModel's fallback brake model, stop distance 0.08 v + 0.0028 v^2 = 19.32 in from 70 in/s, so v^2 / (2 d); guesses until ForesightTuner, TODO(2)

accelInPerS2.provenance: APPROX: DriveModel FALLBACK_FORWARD_SPEED / FORWARD_TIME_CONSTANT (85 / 0.35), its acceleration from rest, under TRACTION_ACCEL 300; optimistic, since DriveModel's acceleration falls as speed rises; TODO(13) DriveModelTuner

maxAngularVelRadPerS.provenance: APPROX: DriveModel TURN_SPEED_PER_VOLT 0.5 x TUNED_VOLTS 12.5, guesses until DriveModelTuner, TODO(13)

defaultPathSpeedFraction.provenance: SET BY HAND: our drives run at full speed unless a path sets its own limit (RobotCommands.driveTo has no speed cap)

settleS.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: DriveModel.SETTLE_SECONDS, TODO(13) time from reaching a path's end to the follower saying it is done

mouths.provenance: APPROX: CAD (ROBOT.md): from the chassis front, 5.72 in ahead of the turret centre, to the intake front at 7.99 in; as wide as the chassis, 2 x AgateFlow.INTAKE_HALF_WIDTH 5.51; TODO(14)

capacity.provenance: SPEC: G407; the rail holds 4 POLLEN (ROBOT.md)

commands.name: shoot
commands.summary: Fires one ball, then stops the feed. Ends after the shot, at once if storage is empty, or after RobotCommands.SHOOT_ONE_TIMEOUT_MS.
commands.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: RobotCommands.shoot(); the estimate is its time limit, SHOOT_ONE_TIMEOUT_MS 1500 ms, TODO(9) time a real shot

commands.name: shootAll
commands.summary: Fires every stored ball in one burst. Ends when storage is empty and the burst is over, or after RobotCommands.SHOOT_ALL_TIMEOUT_MS.
commands.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: RobotCommands.shootAll(); the estimate is its time limit, SHOOT_ALL_TIMEOUT_MS 3000 ms, TODO(9) time a full burst

commands.name: shootAllWithRetry
commands.summary: shootAll; if balls are still stored after it, runs the rail backwards and tries again, up to RobotCommands.SHOOT_RETRIES times.
commands.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: RobotCommands.shootAllWithRetry(); the estimate is its worst case, 3 s + (0.2 s unjam + 3 s) x SHOOT_RETRIES 1, TODO(9)

commands.name: shootContinuous
commands.summary: Shoots whenever a ball is stored and never ends by itself: run it in a parallel step whose deadline is a path.
commands.provenance: SET BY HAND: RobotCommands.shootContinuous(), which has no end of its own

commands.name: flowerDown
commands.summary: Lowers the flower intake. Ends at once; the servo keeps moving after.
commands.provenance: SET BY HAND: RobotCommands.flowerDown(), an instant command

commands.name: flowerUp
commands.summary: Raises the flower intake and waits RobotCommands.FLOWER_RAISE_MS for it, so the next drive starts with it up.
commands.provenance: PLACEHOLDER: RobotCommands.flowerUp(); FLOWER_RAISE_MS 400 ms, TODO(14) film the flower intake coming up

commands.name: waitUntilFull
commands.summary: Waits until storage is full or timeoutMs passes. The rail collects on its own meanwhile.
commands.provenance: SET BY HAND: RobotCommands.waitUntilFull(timeoutMs); the estimate is its upper bound

commands.name: unjam
commands.summary: Runs the rail and intake backwards for ms, then lets go.

conditions.name: storageEmpty
conditions.summary: No POLLEN in storage (the rail's break beams).
conditions.provenance: SET BY HAND: robot.storage.isEmpty(), registered in zenith/TeamZenithRobot

conditions.name: storageFull
conditions.summary: 4 POLLEN in storage: the intake beam at slot 4 trips only then.
conditions.provenance: SET BY HAND: robot.storage.isFull(), registered in zenith/TeamZenithRobot

conditions.name: canFire
conditions.summary: An alliance is picked and the pose is trusted, so the robot may shoot (Robot.canFire()).
conditions.provenance: SET BY HAND: Robot.canFire(), registered in zenith/TeamZenithRobot
